definitions.gloss: (mobile phone) coverage area; service area; area within signal range
definitions.explanation: The geographical area in which a mobile phone or other wireless device can make and receive calls through a carrier's network. Going outside this area results in dropped calls or no signal.

examples.japanese: {通話圏外|つうわけんがい}だ。
{山|やま}の{中|なか}では{通話圏|つうわけん}から{外|はず}れることが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: You often fall out of the coverage area deep in the mountains.

examples.japanese: {契約前|けいやくまえ}に{自宅|じたく}が{通話圏内|つうわけんない}か{確認|かくにん}したほうがよい。
examples.english: Before signing a contract, it's a good idea to check whether your home is in the coverage area.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}は{地下鉄|ちかてつ}の{駅|えき}も{通話圏|つうわけん}に{含|ふく}まれるようになり、ずいぶん{便利|べんり}になった。
examples.english: Recently subway stations have also been brought into the coverage area, which has made things much more convenient.

notes:
Composed of {通話|つうわ} (phone call, communication) and {圏|けん} (sphere, range, zone). A telecommunications term that is most familiar to ordinary users through the phrase {通話圏外|つうわけんがい} (out of the coverage area) displayed on mobile phones.

USAGE:
{通話圏|つうわけん} itself is less commonly seen standalone than as part of the compounds {通話圏内|つうわけんない} (in the coverage area) and {通話圏外|つうわけんがい} (out of the coverage area). These fixed pairs are the practical forms learners will encounter most often.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通話圏内|つうわけんない}: within the coverage area
- {通話圏外|つうわけんがい}: out of the coverage area
- {通話圏|つうわけん}から{外|はず}れる: to fall outside the coverage area
- {通話圏|つうわけん}が{広|ひろ}い: to have a wide coverage area

SIMILAR WORDS:
- サービスエリア: service area — the carrier-marketing term, frequently seen in ads and coverage maps
- {電波|でんぱ}が{届|とど}く: the signal reaches — a more casual way to describe the same idea ("I have reception here")
- {圏外|けんがい}: out of range — the short form commonly shown on a phone's screen when it has no signal
